Download **[budhud.bat](https://github.com/@REPO@/releases/download/@TAG@/budhud.bat)** and run it. It finds TF2, moves the old HUD and mastercomfig aside, and installs this one.

## Checking what you downloaded

`SHA256SUMS` holds the hash of each file, computed by the workflow that built them.

```powershell
Get-FileHash budhud.zip -Algorithm SHA256
```
